# Love Values

> A faith-inclusive, values-first AI relationship confidant. It guides a single
> person to get clear on the values that actually matter to them, surface the
> roots, patterns, and habits shaping how they show up in love, and find a
> partner who can truly see them.

Almost every dating product starts with a photograph. Physical appearance has
near-zero correlation with core values, yet most people cannot name their own
values — let alone a partner's. Love Values starts there instead.

## The method

Four modules, in order:

1. **Values** — a card sort narrowing a master list to 3–5 core values, then
   operationalizing each into a definition, do's, and boundaries. Includes a
   faith branch that is asked, never assumed.
2. **Roots** — concrete childhood questions, including the genuinely good
   qualities in each parent and the traits that were not conducive to
   relationship, held without blame.
3. **Patterns** — how the person actually shows up in love: the gifts they
   bring and the habits that get in the way of them.
4. **Habits** — the daily practices that support or sabotage their stated
   values, measured by trigger rather than frequency.

The AI then reflects it all back as a mirror, not a verdict, and asks whether
it resonates.

## What it is not

Not therapy, psychiatry, counseling, coaching, or mentoring. Not a
compatibility score. Not a grade. The content is AI-generated and may be wrong.

## Pages

- [Home](https://lovevalues.com/): the thesis and how it works
- [Begin](https://lovevalues.com/begin): the intro and legal disclosure gate
- [Journey](https://lovevalues.com/journey): the four-module guided path
- [Review](https://lovevalues.com/review): every question, editable at any time
- [Profile](https://lovevalues.com/profile): the synthesis, and "does this resonate?"
- [Privacy](https://lovevalues.com/privacy): where answers live, in plain language
- [Terms](https://lovevalues.com/terms): what this is and what it isn't

## Notes

Answers are stored in the user's own browser. They are sent to the server only
on an explicit request to generate a profile, used once, and not retained.
Voice transcription happens in-browser; no audio is uploaded.
